meta.name: mass-ulw
meta.description: Run a dependency graph of child agents in one call with the native workflow tool. Use when the user asks for mass-ulw, a DAG of tasks, fan-out/fan-in work, or multi-agent execution where some tasks must wait on others.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 一次调用让多个AI助手按依赖关系协同作业
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你有需要分步完成、且步骤间有先后依赖的复杂任务。
copy.tagline_en: Run dependent AI subtasks together in a single workflow.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a big task that can be split into dependent subtasks.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把复杂任务拆成一张有依赖关系的任务图:先读规划文件,再定义每个任务和先后顺序,一次启动整张图;有依赖的任务会等前置任务完成后自动开始,全图跑完后还会按预定标准核对结果。
howto.when: 当用户要求 mass-ulw、任务 DAG、扇出/扇入等有依赖的多代理执行时触发。

say.text: 把这些子任务按依赖关系用 mass-ulw 编排运行。
say.note: 根据 dependsOn 组织执行顺序。

say.text: 用 mass-ulw 做扇出/扇入:先抓数据,再并行处理,最后汇总。
say.note: 会生成依赖图并监督运行。

howto.what_en: Installed: Claude reads planning doc, defines a task DAG, runs it in one call, starts dependent tasks only after prerequisites finish, and verifies results.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks for mass-ulw, a task DAG, fan-out/fan-in, etc., or any multi-agent job with ordering dependencies.

say_en.text: Run a mass-ulw DAG: A first, then B and C in parallel, D after B/C.
say_en.note: Claude reads planning and defines dependent nodes.

say_en.text: Run these subtasks with mass-ulw, ordered by dependencies.
Use mass-ulw fan-out/fan-in: fetch data, process in parallel, aggregate.
say_en.note: Builds a dependency graph and supervises it.
